intro: At Logic Indicators we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This policy describes what data we collect, how we use it, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, subscribe to our newsletter, or contact us by email. This may include your name, email address, payment information (processed securely by our payment provider), and any content you send us through forms. We also automatically collect technical data when you visit our site, such as your IP address, browser type, pages visited, and response times.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use the information we collect to: (a) process and deliver your purchases; (b) send you communications related to your account, product updates, and technical support; (c) improve our products, services, and site experience; (d) comply with legal and tax obligations; (e) prevent fraud and ensure platform security. We never sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Cookies and Similar Technologies
sections.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, keep your session active, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can configure your browser to reject all cookies, but this may affect the functionality of certain parts of the site.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sections.content: To operate our service we use trusted third-party providers that may process personal data on our behalf: Lemon Squeezy (payment processing), the hosting infrastructure provider, and analytics services. All of these providers comply with recognized security standards and only process the data necessary to provide their service.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. You may also request the portability of your data or limit its processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact us by email at the address listed at the end of this policy. We respond to all requests within a maximum of 30 days.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, unless the law requires or permits a longer retention period. Data from inactive accounts is automatically deleted after 3 years of inactivity.

sections.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this privacy policy periodically. We will notify you of any significant changes by email or through a visible notice on the site. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of this document.

sections.title: 8. Contact
sections.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy or about how we handle your personal data, write to us at info@logicindicators.com. We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.
